title: Phase 8: Synthetic Adversarial Safety Test Suite
rule: UNKNOWN must never silently become stable; omitted regions moving must prevent completion.

cases.name: one_arm_moving_while_other_stops
cases.setup: Left arm stops, right arm moving at 1.2 normalized speed.

cases.name: torso_stopped_while_leg_continues_moving
cases.setup: Torso stops, leg moving at 1.5 normalized speed.

cases.name: required_region_stable_optional_region_moving
cases.setup: TORSO and RIGHT_ARM required and still; optional LEFT_ARM moving at 1.2.

cases.name: optional_region_missing_entirely
cases.setup: TORSO and RIGHT_ARM required and quiet; optional LEFT_ARM has 0 landmarks.

cases.name: low_confidence_required_limb
cases.setup: Required LEFT_ARM has confidence 0.3 (< 0.70) with apparent zero motion.

cases.name: brief_plateau_followed_by_resumed_motion
cases.setup: Quiet dwell begins, but motion resumes before settling dwell completes.
cases.expected: Transitions back to MOVING, zero premature completion

cases.name: slow_continuous_drift
cases.expected: Terminal boundary >= 2000 ms, slow displacement blocks premature completion

cases.name: temporary_coverage_recovery_during_ongoing_movement
cases.setup: Coverage recovers to 0.95 while motion is 1.5.
cases.expected: movementEvidence == TRUE, quietEvidence == FALSE, stays MOVING
